customManagers.description: Track the pinned ComplianceAsCode/content release in config/content.yaml

prBodyNotes: After merge, refresh the pinned checksum and regenerate the charts:
make update-sha   # rewrites config/content.yaml sha512 for the new version
make generate     # regenerates charts/ and RULES.md
Review the diff of `charts/` and `RULES.md`: it shows exactly which rules and fixes changed between content releases.
